prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Walnut Shaft inventory icon, a straight walnut shaft shaped and seasoned for rods and staves. Dark chocolate walnut wood with warm brown highlights and sinuous grain with readable natural longitudinal grain, subtle tool-planed facets and beveled cut ends. Plain crafting intermediate, no hardware or decoration. Diagonally bottom left to upper right, entire object visible, substantial thickness readable at 48px, square canvas with 12 percent transparent margin. Studio key light upper left, textured material and strong dimensional shading matching realistic fantasy inventory art. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No floor, cast shadow, text, frame, watermark, hands, or other objects. Not flat vector or crude cylinder.
